grounding.observation: Retained correction4 FAIL and actual13 phase images drive this repair.
grounding.comparison: Head dip and impactFX improvements do not waive rigid rider or full-speed evidence.

expert_coverage.observation: Rider balance is derived relative to horse root and timed load, with contact-linked absorption and neck ownership measurements.
expert_coverage.comparison: The previous negative torso pitch compounded backward root inclination; adding arbitrary sway would not resolve this.

film_alignment.comparison: No simplified supporting actor is accepted by a functional pose test.

preferences.observation: Keep corrections internal and cumulative; no unnecessary Director method approval.
preferences.comparison: Full-speed AV still requires the Director; agent owns measurable and frame-visible failures.

reference_roles.observation: Faithful reference governs rider balance through lift/crest/contact, not absolute pixel coordinates.
reference_roles.comparison: Different anatomy and camera do not excuse a backward rigid-body pose.

method.observation: Critically damped torso response uses forward counterbalance and post-contact18mm drop; explicit neck endpoint prevents inherited control translation.
method.comparison: Unit tests bound response, prohibit pre-contact absorption and retain stable late rest; actual scene remains discriminating test.

interfaces.observation: Connected upper actor hierarchy remains together; reins/spear follow updated palms; four neck segments measured across190 frames.
interfaces.comparison: Neither a valid length ratio nor coupled parent proves natural cloth, hand or head performance; phase inspection can reject them.

efficient_quality.observation: Existing assets and13 local phase frames; no whole trailer rerender.
efficient_quality.comparison: No time saving or artistic pass claimed from test counts.

authority.observation: Same task correction5/max6; third additional correction within exact approval.
authority.comparison: No cloud, new tools, provider, spend or appearance-task extension.

strongest_counterexample: Forward upper-body compensation can become a hinge at the waist, and explicit head positioning may alter the rein span. Inspect seat/chest/head/arms together; the damped response and length bounds are safeguards, not a proxy for natural performance.
